title: 法国打击“分离主义”法案引争议
desc: 法国打击“分离主义”法案引争议

paragraphs.en: France has been gripped this month by the so-called Charlie Hebdo trial against the alleged accomplices of Islamists, who attacked a French satirical newspaper and a kosher supermarket in 2015.
paragraphs.zh: 本月，法国正深陷所谓的《查理周刊》案审判之中，该案针对2015年袭击一家法国讽刺报纸和一家犹太洁食超市的伊斯兰主义者的涉嫌同谋者。

paragraphs.en: It was the first of a string of terror attacks along with the Islamist insurgency in the Middle East and elsewhere that fed a broader zeroing in on radical islam here.
paragraphs.zh: 这是中东及其他地区伊斯兰叛乱引发的一系列恐怖袭击中的第一起，这让更多的人把矛头对准了这里的激进伊斯兰。

paragraphs.en: This recent history partly forms the backdrop of upcoming legislation on so-called separatisms.
paragraphs.zh: 这段近代史在一定程度上构成了即将出台的所谓分离立法的背景。

paragraphs.en: Details are sketchy but reports suggest the bill will crack down on importing foreign imams and foreign financing of private schools, and increase surveillance on suspect groups.
paragraphs.zh: 细节尚不清楚，但有报道称，该法案将打击外国伊玛目入境和私立学校的外国融资，并加强对可疑群体的监控。

paragraphs.en: The government says it aims to fight so-called enemies of France, of French values and way of life.
paragraphs.zh: 政府表示，其目标是打击所谓的法国价值观和生活方式的敌人。

paragraphs.en: Officials say those enemies also include groups like white supremacists.
paragraphs.zh: 官员们说，这些敌人还包括白人至上主义者等组织。

paragraphs.en: Alexandre del Valle welcomes the legislation. He co-authored a book about the Muslim Brotherhood's alleged quest to infiltrate and conquer the West.
paragraphs.zh: 亚历山大·德尔·瓦莱对这项立法表示欢迎。他与人合著了一本书，内容是关于所谓穆斯林兄弟会试图渗透并征服西方一事。

paragraphs.en: I think it's necessary first of all to ban any organization that jeopardize our western, French, Republican and secular value.
paragraphs.zh: 我认为首先有必要取缔任何危害我们西方、法国、共和及世俗价值观的组织。

paragraphs.en: First of it, Muslim Brotherhood are the most fanatics among the radical islam organization.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，穆斯林兄弟会是激进伊斯兰组织中最狂热的团体。

paragraphs.en: Government officials say the measure does not intend to target moderate islam.
paragraphs.zh: 政府官员说，这项措施并不打算针对温和的伊斯兰教。

paragraphs.en: A recent doxa poll shows most French surveyed approve of a separatism bill.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的一项多克萨民意调查显示，大多数接受调查的法国人赞成一项分离主义法案。

paragraphs.en: But some Muslim leaders and groups worry it will unfairly single them out.
paragraphs.zh: 但一些穆斯林领袖和团体担心这会不公平地将他们单独挑出来。

paragraphs.en: Violence doesn't belong to a certain community. Terrorism doesn't belong to a single community.
paragraphs.zh: 暴力不属于某个特定群体。恐怖主义也不属于某个单一群体。

paragraphs.en: But it's not right to stigmatize a whole community because one member committed terrorist attacks.
paragraphs.zh: 但因为一名成员实施了恐怖袭击就给整个群体贴上污名化的标签是不对的。

paragraphs.en: Groups like Bashar cite an uptick in anti-Muslim acts and intolerance in recent years.
paragraphs.zh: 像巴沙尔这样的团体指出，近年来反穆斯林行为和不容忍现象有所增加。

paragraphs.en: Some observers say politics is behind the separatism bill, claiming president Macron and his centrist On the Move party are tilting right ahead of the 2022 elections.
paragraphs.zh: 一些观察人士认为，这项分离主义法案背后存在政治因素，声称总统马克龙及其中间派政党“复兴党”正在2022年大选前向右倾斜。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, France's main opposition party, the far-right National Rally, says Macro is being too soft on extremism and is calling for an end to any system that encourages ethnic communities to function apart from the mainstream.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，法国主要反对党、极右翼政党“国民联盟”表示，马克龙对极端主义过于软弱，并呼吁终止任何鼓励族裔群体与主流社会脱节的制度。

paragraphs.en: What we want is a fight without mercy against communitarianism and separatism.
paragraphs.zh: 我们想要的是一场毫不留情地打击社群主义和分离主义的斗争。

paragraphs.en: But that means treating the politics at the roots, rethinking migration policy, closing Salafist mosques, banning financing for suspect associations.
paragraphs.zh: 但这意味着要从根源上处理政治问题，重新思考移民政策，关闭萨拉菲派清真寺，禁止向可疑组织提供资金支持。

paragraphs.en: There are a number of tools. So far, none has been used.
paragraphs.zh: 有很多工具。到目前为止，还没有一个被使用过。

paragraphs.en: Lots of expectations and fears about what fighting separatism really means, especially for France's Muslim community.
paragraphs.zh: 关于打击分离主义究竟意味着什么，尤其是对法国穆斯林群体而言，存在着许多期待与担忧。
